title: Illusion of Attention
coreMove: Test the appearance created by attention, then replace it with a visible check on reality.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Illusion of Attention as a specific decision error around attention, invisible gorilla, cell phone. Traceable support includes Association Between Cellular-Telephone Calls and Motor Vehicle Collisions.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Illusion of Attention as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: test the appearance created by attention, then replace it with a visible check on reality.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Illusion of Attention.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Illusion of Attention sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
No example may skip the specific mechanics of Illusion of Attention.
